purpose: Single authoritative source-validity enum for feat entries. Generated reports and eligibility gates should consume this registry instead of independently re-adjudicating whether a feat name is a real SWSE feat.
notes: Absence from this registry means a feat has not yet been run through a dedicated validity audit — it is NOT an implicit claim that the entry is verified.

Entries below were adjudicated in docs/audits/strict-combat-bucket-feat-validity-audit-2026-07-03.json, which records explicit user confirmation (see that file's inputs.manualAdjudication) that these names are not legal SWSE feats, or in Delay Damage's case, are a class feature rather than a feat.

invalid_not_swse_feat / class_feature_not_feat entries remain present as compendium documents in data/feat-catalog.json and packs/feats.db as of this registry's creation. They must be excluded from implementation queues, readiness reports, and chargen eligibility going forward; removing them from the shipped compendium is a separate follow-up decision, not made by this registry.
